name: Mcpx
description:
Interactively explore MCP server tools and their input schemas.

mcpx lets you drill down from server → tool → schema to understand what each tool expects. Browse all configured MCP servers, inspect available tools, and view full input schemas — without leaving Claude Code.
longDescription:
Ships **1 command**, `browse` (Interactively browse MCP server tools and their input schemas) and **1 hook**, `hooks.json`.

Installs with `claude plugin install mcpx@claude-community` from `yn01/claude-plugins` (`plugins/mcpx`).

A Claude Code plugin to interactively explore MCP server tools and their input schemas. Drill down from server → tool → schema to inspect what each tool expects.
